note: Re-judged 2026-10-30 by an independent auditor after the userns conversion. The unit's only change since the last verdict is userns.Enter(t) as its first statement (the child re-runs the whole body in its own user, network and mount namespace; a child failure or skip propagates to the parent, and a child that ran nothing fails it) plus removal of EPERM/EACCES skips, so a refused privilege now fails instead of skipping. Assertions are byte-identical. Section 3: 'The TTL of GTSM-enabled sessions MUST NOT be decremented.' Single positive per the owner's local-output scope. TestGTSMConfiguredEgressDoesNotDecrement dials with RealDialer OutTTL 255 over a two-namespace veth and fails unless every captured packet from 192.0.2.1 carries TTL exactly 255 and both the SYN and the exact data payload are seen; newTCPEgress now fails instead of skipping on a refused namespace. Producer network.go DialContext through ttl_linux.go setIPTTL before the SYN; an omission or a 254 fails the on-wire assertion.
